settings.name_in_paper: Federated contextual bandit, centralized environment with a controller, (eps, delta, M)-federated differential privacy
unmapped: M agents each facing the same linear bandit; regret is group pseudoregret summed over agents

settings.definition_quote: At every trial $t \in [T]$, each agent $i \in [M]$ is presented with a decision set $\mathcal D_{i, t} \subset \mathbb R^d$ ... reward $y_{i, t} = \bm x_{i, t}^\top \bm \theta^* + \eta_{i, t}$ ... Assumptions (a) bounded action set ... (c) bounded target parameter ... (d) sub-Gaussian rewards ... (e) compact decision set ... (f) bounded reward

settings.name_in_paper: Federated contextual bandit, decentralized peer-to-peer environment with delays, federated differential privacy
unmapped: agents communicate over a connected graph G with messages forwarded up to gamma hops (LOCAL protocol), causing communication delays
group pseudoregret summed over M agents
settings.definition_quote: The communication network is denoted by an undirected (connected) graph $\mathcal G = (V, E)$ ... This message is forwarded from agent to agent $\gamma$ times (taking one trial of the bandit problem each between forwards), after which it is dropped.
